note: Passages preprocessed by scripts/lib/text.mjs toProse, so our formulas and textstat score identical bytes and only formula internals differ. Reference scores computed once with textstat. Tolerance: plus or minus one grade per formula.

tolerance.ari_note: textstat counts punctuation in ARI characters; we follow the original Senter and Smith 1967 definition (letters and digits). The difference scales with punctuation density, so the tolerance is wider. The micro-fixture in tests/formulas.test.mjs pins our exact definition by hand.

passage_note: Passages avoid titled names (Mr., Mrs.): the reference tool splits sentences at those periods and ours correctly does not, which would turn a reference flaw into a test failure. Our abbreviation handling is asserted directly in tests/text.test.mjs.
